bivariate_multiple_testing: BH FDR across every locally h2-eligible pair-locus row in the three frozen pairs; failed eligible attempts contribute p=1

conditional_covariate_rationale.A: BMI and clinically defined sleep apnea are the smallest directly justified set for testing adiposity and sleep-disordered-breathing explanations of snoring-lifespan local sharing.
conditional_covariate_rationale.B: Major depressive disorder is the single predeclared broad psychiatric competing architecture for insomnia-ADHD; adding metabolic, smoking, and vascular traits without a locus-specific rationale would overcondition.
conditional_covariate_rationale.CONTROL: The positive control is used for pipeline concordance and has no predeclared conditional headline test.

A.rationale: Separately tests whether BMI-related local genetic signal attenuates snoring-lifespan sharing.
Separately tests whether clinically defined sleep-apnea local genetic signal attenuates snoring-lifespan sharing.

B.rationale: Tests the single predeclared broad psychiatric competing architecture for insomnia-ADHD.

local_method_robustness.execution_rule: Use an ancestry-matched independently implemented local method only when its reference and software pass provenance gates; do not substitute overlapping peaks for a robustness result.

interpretation_policy.conditional_attenuation_formula: 1 - abs(conditioned_local_rg) / abs(unconditioned_local_rg); negative values denote strengthened absolute sharing after conditioning
interpretation_policy.conditional_rule: UNSTABLE for a failed model, non-finite estimate, or sign reversal; UNDERPOWERED when any conditioner fails the same-locus h2 gate; among valid same-direction estimates, INDEPENDENT_LOCAL_COMPONENT requires conditional FDR<=0.05 and <25% absolute attenuation, FULLY_ATTENUATED requires conditional FDR>0.05 and >=75% absolute attenuation, and all other valid results are PARTIALLY_ATTENUATED.
interpretation_policy.local_rule: For each pair, FDR-supported loci with both positive and negative directions are OPPOSING_LOCAL_EFFECTS; otherwise two or more FDR-supported loci are MULTIPLE_LOCAL_LOCI and one is STRONG_LOCAL_SHARING. Successfully tested nonsignificant rows are NO_LOCAL_SHARING; rows without a valid bivariate test are UNDERPOWERED.

reference: LAVA UK Biobank European v1.1 100000-person LD reference
conditional_execution_gate: Run each frozen partial-local model only for primary bivariate rows passing Track B BH FDR<=0.05 and only when every conditioner in that model passes the same locus-level univariate threshold
conditional_multiple_testing: BH FDR across every model-locus row eligible for conditional testing; failed eligible attempts contribute p=1 and conditioner-ineligible rows are excluded
